== Title ==
<span lang="ja">中型輸送艇</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1名のパイロットと4名の乗客、1つのビークルを乗せられる。配備と移動に関しては、宇宙戦闘機と同様に扱う。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ギャロフリー・ヤーズ製の人員／貨物輸送艇。巨大な貨物庫は艤装次第で多数の兵員や弾薬、補給物資などを収容できる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Medium Transport.

'''Lore''' — A personnel and cargo transport built by Gallofree Yards. Its huge cargo bays can, depending on outfitting, hold many troops, munitions, and supplies.

'''Game text''' — May carry 1 pilot, 4 passengers, and 1 vehicle. Treat deploy and move like a starfighter. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard.

Printed subtype is 大型艦：輸送艇. Lore omits “safely”. Game text uses 乗せられる, 宇宙戦闘機, ドッキング能力, and 専属パイロット.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-mediumtransport.gif|Original English face]], [[Medium Transport]].</ref>
